newsitem.title: USA: TransCanada files $720 mln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: TransCanada files $720 mln debt shelf.

text.p: TransCanada PipeLines Ltd filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration of up to $720 million in debt securities.
When combined with a previous registration, the offering totals up to $1 billion in debt securities, the Calary-based natural gas pipeline company said.

Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, including financing construction programs as well as repaying outstanding debt. No underwriters were named in the shelf registration.
